value.rationale: A natural full first Steiner coefficient for every standard two-row Monge polytope, with exact all-index coordinate area spectrum, exact wall aggregate, strict exponential spread and distinct triangular versus Gaussian area transition. The q-1 comparison facets occupy asymptotically only one-third of combinatorial facets but nearly all boundary area. This is a substantive geometric metric law beyond known volume or facet census.
